WITH price_diff AS (
  SELECT p.product_category_name AS category,
         ROUND(AVG(pph.new_price - pph.old_price), 2) AS avg_price_diff
  FROM product_price_history pph
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = pph.product_id
  WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.product_category_name
),
order_counts AS (
  SELECT p.product_category_name AS category,
         COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM products p
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM product_price_history pph
      WHERE pph.product_id = p.product_id
    )
  GROUP BY p.product_category_name
)
SELECT pd.category AS product_category_name,
       pd.avg_price_diff,
       COALESCE(oc.order_count, 0) AS order_count
FROM price_diff pd
LEFT JOIN order_counts oc ON oc.category = pd.category
ORDER BY order_count DESC, product_category_name ASC
LIMIT 20;
